stock_dt.limitation: captured partition DT selection merge, not Android runtime FDT with bootloader fixups

stock_fv_evidence.observation: Stock regulation reads the final voltage row (size - 1) of cur_volt_para. The nine-column temperature record has no independent normal/FFC FV fields. R90 derives each missing FV from the final parsed voltage row, preserving all voltage and stage entries.
stock_fv_evidence.limit: Evidence for terminal FV compatibility only, not equivalence of the complete replacement driver.
